text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I see... So customer traffic really is 
dropping... 
Uuuuughhhhhh......."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... And looking at our customer 
flow... 
—I feel there are very few repeat 
customers."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"At first, more customers came, drawn in 
by the wagashi sweet-off and the impact of 
our novel sweets, but..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"At this time of year, Western 
confectionery shops release tons of new 
items too, right? 
So maybe relying on novel ideas alone 
caused us to get lost in the crowd..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Then, what if we advertise even more?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"No, that won't solve the root problem. 
The difference between us and other 
Valentine's sweets—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I think we need to pursue 'the essential 
appeal of wagashi, unique only to 
wagashi.'"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: 'The essential appeal of wagashi', huh...?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huuuuummmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Um, about that...! 
There's something I'd like everyone to 
hear!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If this goes well... we might be able 
to increase our repeat customers...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan! Cafe...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To me, wagashi tastes like the fond 
memories of relaxin' 
with my family back in the countryside, 
sippin' tea together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So, I reckon that's the true charm of 
wagashi!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A treat you can enjoy leisurely with your 
family or friends... 
How about we make wagashi like that?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see... yes... yes! Absolutely! 
Sweets meant to be shared with family... 
will definitely bring them back!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If we add wagashi like that to our lineup, 
I'm sure we'll see more repeat customers!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It's definitely worth a shot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's settled, let's get right to 
it! 
Time to make the perfect wagashi for a 
relaxing time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so these are our customer service 
outfits! 
I'm all fired up!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They just arrived today♪ 
Now then... for family-oriented wagashi—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A milk-chocolate-based wagashi for the 
kids... 
and perhaps traditional wagashi for the 
parents.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... In that case, why not make 
a 
Bakushin Set that the whole family can 
enjoy together?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I love that, Bakushin O-chan! With the 
theme of a family tea time, 
our motif will be... the flowers 
decorating the table! A flower garden!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A Bakushin-style stroke of genius! Let's 
put popping candy 
inside the sweets! Children will love it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then let's shape them like present boxes! 
How about placing a few of them in the 
center of the flower garden?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! 
Like mystery surprise boxes! That sounds 
so exciting!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since the flowers are for adults, we'll 
keep the colors subtle and calm. 
And the present boxes will have cute 
decorations♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my gosh...! 
You two are in perfect sync...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The two who were clashing in the wagashi 
showdown are now joining 
hands to make a single confection... Ngh, 
that is so intensely awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because they respect each 
other... 
that their synergy multiplies tenfold...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we can't let ourselves fall 
behind either! 
Let's get the posters and flyers ready for 
the new creations!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right. It'd be nice if we had some stylish 
wrapping, too...! 
Something family-friendly that matches the 
new sweets...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I... had a small idea too. 
Not just for the wrapping and packaging, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If we decorate the entire shop to match 
the sweets' theme... 
I think that might be delightful.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! That's a great idea, Cafe!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely do that! 
Once we finish making the sweets, let's 
all go shopping for supplies together!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You seem like you're having fun, 
Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You too, Yukino-san... 
...No. I'm sure... we all feel the exact 
same way.
